dataFlow: Entry: repos/metabob-activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts:599 (POST /executions handler) → Transform: Execution result object → WebSocketMessage with type, timestamp, data → Broadcast: WebSocketBroadcaster.emit() iterates clients Set, calls ws.send(JSON.stringify(message)) → Exit: Dashboard useWebSocket hook onMessage callback receives parsed event, updates React state

summary.currentState: Activity execution system records results to database and updates Thompson Sampling metrics. Dashboard polls GET /executions every 5 seconds for updates. WebSocket client infrastructure exists but server not implemented.
summary.desiredState: Real-time event-driven updates where activity executions immediately broadcast events to all connected dashboard clients via WebSocket. Dashboard receives updates within 100ms without polling.
blockers: Bun server not configured to accept WebSocket upgrades
Execution handler not emitting events to broadcaster

ready: Execution history endpoint exists for initial data load
needed: Event emission at 3 trigger points in execution handler

implementationOrder: Step 2: Add WebSocket configuration to repos/metabob-activity-api/src/index.ts Bun.serve() call
Step 3: Import broadcaster in repos/metabob-activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts and emit 3 event types
Step 4: Update repos/activity-dashboard/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx to use useWebSocket hook
Step 5: Test end-to-end: MiniBob execution → verify dashboard updates in real-time
validationCriteria: WebSocket connection established on dashboard mount with status indicator showing 'connected'
MiniBob activity execution triggers execution_started event received by dashboard within 100ms
Dashboard UI updates immediately showing new execution in progress
Upon completion, execution_completed event updates status and metrics without page refresh
Template metrics (success rate, avg duration, avg cost) update in real-time
Multiple dashboard clients receive same events simultaneously
Disconnected clients auto-reconnect within 5 seconds and resume receiving events
No polling requests to GET /executions after initial load

risks.risk: Broadcast scalability - many clients create O(n) overhead per event
risks.mitigation: Limit to 100 concurrent clients, add rate limiting, consider Redis pub/sub for horizontal scaling

risks.risk: Reconnection storms if many clients disconnect simultaneously
risks.mitigation: Exponential backoff with jitter already implemented in useWebSocket hook

risks.risk: Authentication bypass if WebSocket accepts unauthenticated connections
risks.mitigation: Validate JWT token on WebSocket upgrade, disconnect invalid clients immediately

risks.risk: Multi-tenant data leak if events not filtered by session/org
risks.mitigation: Add session.orgId filter in broadcaster, only emit to clients with matching orgId
